questions.solution:

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The letter was being typed by the secretary when the phone rang.

options.text: The secretary will type the letter when the phone rings.
The secretary types the letter when the phone rings.
The secretary was typing the letter when the phone rang.
The secretary is typing the letter when the phone rings.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**The secretary was typing the letter when the phone rang.**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the active voice, the subject performs the action expressed by the verb. Here, "The secretary" is the subject performing the action "was typing".
 
• The sentence structure changes from passive to active by making the subject (the secretary) come before the verb (was typing).
 
• The other options do not match the tense and context of the original sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The secretary was typing__ the letter when the phone rang.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** The secretary will type the letter when the phone rings. (Incorrect tense)
 
• **Option 2:** The secretary types the letter when the phone rings. (Incorrect tense)
 
• **Option 4:** The secretary is typing the letter when the phone rings. (Incorrect tense)

questions.question:
In the following sentence, four words are underlined out of which one word is misspelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

I took out a water__ tumbler__(A) for a drink, but found the water in the metal __container__ (B) had frozen so I couldn't __quanch __(C) my thirst. I ate some biscuits and __offered__ (D) some to Hillary.

• The correct sentence should be: "I took out a water tumbler for a drink, but found the water in the metal container had frozen so I couldn't quench my thirst. I ate some biscuits and offered some to Hillary."

questions.question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence to

form a meaningful sentence.

(P) an open mind

(Q) seek it with

(O) for personal growth and development

(R) knowledge is a powerful tool
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**option 4**'.

• The sentence formed is: "Knowledge is a powerful tool for personal growth and development, seek it with an open mind."

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Solutions to the country’s interior problems are still a long way away.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"interior problems"** is incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"internal problems"** because "internal" refers to issues *within* a country, while "interior" generally refers to physical or geographical aspects, such as the *interior of a building* or *a country’s interior region.*

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Correct Sentence:** *Solutions to the country's internal problems are still a long way away.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Problems are still**: This part is grammatically correct and does not need any changes.
 
• **A long way away**: This phrase is correctly used to indicate distance in terms of time or effort.
 
• **Solutions to**: This is the correct preposition usage for introducing the problems that need solving.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

He must deliver pizza.

options.text: Pizza has to be delivered by him.
Pizza have to be delivered by him.
Pizza must be delivered by him.
Pizza can be delivered by him.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Pizza must be delivered by him.**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in active voice: "He must deliver pizza."
 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject: "Pizza."
 
• The auxiliary verb "must" remains the same in passive voice.
 
• The main verb "deliver" changes to its past participle form "delivered."
 
• "By him" indicates the doer of the action in passive voice.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Pizza must be delivered by him.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Pizza has to be delivered by him.** - Incorrect, as "has to" is not equivalent to "must."
 
• **Option 2: Pizza have to be delivered by him.** - Incorrect, as "have to" is not equivalent to "must" and "Pizza" is singular, so "has to" is required.
 
• **Option 4: Pizza can be delivered by him.** - Incorrect, as "can" is not equivalent to "must."
